rationale: Build on the current best quant-aware/FP16-tail/EMA path with a minimal deep-tail carry gate instead of another slower recurrent pass. Recent tail-reuse runs were close but lost wallclock to extra block work; this reuses a stabilized late decoder state across the last decoder blocks with fixed shapes, tiny FP32 control tensors, and no changes to the final int8 roundtrip path. I also removed an unused field and compressed a few helpers so the script stays under the 1500-line cap.
title: Gated Tail State Carryover On Best Quant Path
